title: rp-a -> rp-b -> rp-a, both levels delegate create and get; inner frame registers

note: L3 §5.1.3/§5.1.4.1 allow cross-origin create/get with delegation and activation, and clientData.crossOrigin=true (topOrigin rp-a); the matrix plan sends a foreign-ancestor chain to the browser. UNCERTAIN: Firefox support for delegated cross-origin create.
